description: Source housing and PCB with dimensioned visual representations of the other Dash device parts.

enclosure.note: User-supplied original STL triangle geometry; viewer applies the assembly transform.

pcb.presentation: Black solder mask; source placements and geometry retained.
pcb.note: Package-library fallbacks and the unresolved LS1 PCB connector body are documented in assembly.json and README.md.

battery.label: 192535 3.7V 1000mAh LiPo
battery.source: User-estimated dimensions and supplied electrical rating
battery.note: Manufacturer identity is unverified. Battery location is illustrative; it is outside the enclosure in the supplied build photos.

display.note: The current -80 manufacturer page identifies a bare 30-pin panel. The supplied photographs establish a four-pin module, but its exact revision is unverified. Geometry is guided by the equivalent 88/89 manufacturer module drawing.

speaker.note: Body thickness and mounting geometry use the manufacturer 2831BOX-2.0-L150 family drawing, an 8Ω/2.0mm connector sibling. This is a family representation, not exact manufacturer CAD for C49247039.

batteryConnection.note: The referenced -M housing is green; natural ivory with the same housing geometry is used as requested. Plug form follows the official JST PH drawing.

magnetsTouchPlateAndWires.source: Supplied build photographs and housing features
magnetsTouchPlateAndWires.note: Dimensioned visual representations with illustrative placement and wire routing; no manufacturer part drawings were supplied.

limitations: Additional device parts are presentation geometry. Their placement, cable routing and enclosure clearances have not been validated as manufacturing CAD or by a physical fit check.
